citation: Rep. Pat Meehan will have to step aside, Republican insiders say
title: Rep. Pat Meehan will have to step aside, Republican insiders say
notes: Chosen from New Gray's ranked list of three reports (the Inquirer's report of 2018-01-25 that Republicans expected Rep. Meehan to leave the race, to locate; the Inquirer's report of his announcement; NBC News's) as the first that Wayback holds and that passes, its decisive sentence read by eye on the author's words; the other two were not read. Located by one search query; its address carries the day, 20180125. By Jonathan Tamari. The capture, of 00:48:37 UTC on 2019-07-29, is a later copy and Wayback's first of this address; the page prints Posted: January 25, 2018 - 1:09 PM, with no zone (taken as Eastern, 18:09 UTC). It reports, before his announcement, that Pennsylvania Republicans "increasingly believe" that he "will not be able to run for reelection this fall", according to interviews with a half-dozen party officials and insiders, and that one, "who has been in touch with Meehan's congressional aides", said that "a departure is all but certain"; that he "had not made a decision as of Thursday morning", 2018-01-25; and that Republican political leaders in Washington and Pennsylvania "have not commented on his future". It names no leader or party committee demanding that he leave the race: unnamed Republicans only, the row's answer. Read by capture only.
